# Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result), ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only), ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw / raw.sum()

    # Compute losses
    loss_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result * weights, axis=1)
    loss_call = -np.sum(logp_call_only * weights, axis=1)
    loss_no = -np.sum(logp_no_call * weights, axis=1)

    # Baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no, loss_call)
    margin = L_minus - loss_with
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
